metadata.siteDescription: A scalable platform for student councils — visual pages, task tracking, profiles, and Telegram automation in one place.
metadata.homeDescription: A scalable platform for student councils — visual pages, task tracking, profiles, and Telegram automation in one place.

home.heroDescription: Nexus unifies pages, tasks, profiles, and Telegram automation into one scalable platform — built for councils that need clarity, accountability, and a polished public presence.
home.sidebarItem1: Publish institutional content with the visual editor
home.sidebarItem2: Run tasks, groups, and calendar-driven operations
home.sidebarItem3: Connect members through profiles, mentions, and Telegram

visualPages.title: Visual pages
visualPages.description: Publish news, guides, and landing content with the Puck editor — layouts, media, and forms without shipping new code.

tasksProjects.title: Tasks & projects
tasksProjects.description: Dispatch work, track acknowledgement, and coordinate multi-part projects with reminders and institutional calendars.

telegramWorkspaces.title: Telegram workspaces
telegramWorkspaces.description: Spin up dedicated project groups, collect reports in chat, and keep council operations close to where members already are.

home.overviewTitle: Everything your institution needs to operate in the open
home.overviewDescription: Nexus is a containerized management and automation platform: configurable global layout, membership applications, access control, media storage, rich text with mentions, and admin tooling — all on top of a dynamic site background that stays readable thanks to solid glass islands like these.

generalRules.title: Content policy, tasks & Telegram copy
generalRules.description: Manage blocked words, weak-password denylist, user-facing validation messages, task delegation quotas, task scoring categories, and Telegram bot templates. Numeric fields (group numbers, phones) are never scanned by the language filter.
generalRules.blockedWordsHint: One term per line. Optional category: term | profanity. Applies to prose fields and rich text — not numbers.
generalRules.weakPasswordsHint: One password per line. Used at signup and password change.
generalRules.delegationIntro: Maximum number of times a performer may delegate a task to someone else. Leave blank or check "Unlimited" for no cap at that tier.
generalRules.taskCategoriesIntro: Categories define the allowed base score (B) range per assignment type and default Q/T coefficient percents. Used on task create and in the task list filter.
generalRules.telegramTabIntro: For a focused bot-only workspace, open <link>Telegram Bot Messages</link>.
generalRules.blockedMessageHint: Shown in forms and the rich text editor when prose contains a blocked term.
generalRules.weakPasswordMessageHint: Shown when a user picks a denylisted password.

sanitize.description: When Puck page saves strip unsafe links, media URLs, or rich HTML, a record is stored here. Raw malicious payloads are never persisted — only field paths and length metadata.

userDirectory.description: Records admin changes from the User Directory: profile edits, hierarchy moves, delegated permissions, socium labels, and account deletions. Payloads store field keys and safe metadata only — no email, phone, or login handles of the target user.
